deviations_from_card: Coordinator revision added: 4 page cases run index.html's scripts (witness.js + scoreboard.js) in a node vm with a stubbed fetch and a minimal fake DOM, firing DOMContentLoaded: rewritten-then-longer -> bad 'Rewritten' and the page must have fetched /v1/house/prefix?rows=10 (red before: page never fetched, read ok 'Checked against 1 earlier look'); matching prefix -> ok 'Extends' and the new look stored with its signature; prefix signed by another key -> bad; 429 -> unknown (critic note). Check title changed to 'Nothing in the record was removed or rewritten'. 'Save this look' replaces the old 'Download the signed head' link (critic: duplication) and downloads as house-head.json (not house-head-<rows>.json) so the printed table-verify command still matches. Kept-file check asks at most 5 prefixes (receipt head first, then newest) since a proof file may carry 1000 heads. Commits are two feat commits with tests inside (not test-then-feat) so each commit is green; witness.test.mjs landed helper-only in the first. Rust clippy/test were run with cargo directly using the same CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR/TEMP that scripts/cargo.ps1 sets, because pwsh -File swallows the '--' before -D warnings.
notes: Red before: 6 helper cases (no witness.js), 4 page cases (page renders ok, no prefix fetch), glass_tests route case (panicked at the /house/witness.js asset assert). hosted.rs touched only in the router (one .route line). One sibling compile error in crates/table-runtime/src/publish_tests.rs blocked clippy once and was gone on re-run (not mine). Looks are now saved only when proven extended, or always where Ed25519 is missing; a 429 does not save, so the next refresh asks again. UNVERIFIED: not opened in a real browser (node WebCrypto Ed25519 only); the kept-file UI path has no automated test beyond witnessVerdict.
